product_metadata.title: YANXUAN Gel Memory Foam Pillow, Ventilated Bed Pillow with Washable Cover, Pillows for Back & Side Sleeper, King
features: 【Ergonomic Design】This contour memory foam pillow is ergonomic designed according to the special shape of human body, which cradles your head, neck, and shoulders to provide high-quality support, pressure relief, and temperature-regulating respite. Designed to hold up to hospitality standards, this pillow is sure to maintain comfort at home.

【Comfortable & Safe】Our contour pillow is made of premium gel-infused memory foam which is certified by ISPA, proven that no harmful chemicals are used in the memory foam core. It comes with a hypoallergenic pillow case certified by OEKO-TEK, IN CASE you experience an odor which is a “Fresh Foam” odor, It is harmless. The odor should dissipate within several days.

【Soft & Supportive】Made of unique slow rebound memory foam that “remembers” the curve of your neck and adapts to your shape, this cervical pillow is designed with the perfect balance between firmness and comfort - High density memory foam properly aligns your spine while sleeping (suitable for side & back sleepers) - Perfect height (not too high or low) helps ease neck pain.

【Ventilated Design】Pincore technology creates a ventilated design that optimizes air circulation for prime airflow and temperature control. With three different sizes to choose from and a comfortable mid-loft design, this pillow is great for back, stomach, and side sleepers.

【Satisfaction Guarantee】YANXUAN pay most attention to customer service and product quality, our highly trained experts are here for you 24/7/365. We offer a 10-YEAR QUALITY WARRANTY and additionally a 30-DAY SATISFACTION GUARANTEE for this memory foam pillow, if you have encounted any problems, please feel free to contact us anytime.
